#!/bin/bash

WORDLIST="/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt"
EXECUTABLE="./rockyou"

if [ ! -f "$WORDLIST" ]; then
    echo "Wordlist not found: $WORDLIST"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$EXECUTABLE" ]; then
    echo "Executable not found or not executable: $EXECUTABLE"
    exit 1
fi

while IFS= read -r password; do
    echo "Trying: $password"
    echo "$password" | "$EXECUTABLE"
    
    # Check exit status to determine success
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Password found: $password"
        exit 0
    fi
done < "$WORDLIST"

echo "Password not found in wordlist."
exit 1

#!/bin/bash

WORDLIST="/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt"
EXECUTABLE="./rockyou"

if [ ! -f "$WORDLIST" ]; then
    echo "Wordlist not found: $WORDLIST"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -x "$EXECUTABLE" ]; then
    echo "Executable not found or not executable: $EXECUTABLE"
    exit 1
fi

while IFS= read -r password; do
    echo "Trying: $password"
    echo "$password" | "$EXECUTABLE"
    
    # Check exit status to determine success
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Password found: $password"
        exit 0
    fi
done < "$WORDLIST"

echo "Password not found in wordlist."
exit 1
